name: Bitwarden
description: Fill logins from your Bitwarden vault with :bw.exe, and sign in to sites with passkeys kept there, using the Bitwarden command-line app (bw.exe).

settings.label: Where bw.exe is
settings.hint: Leave empty to find bw.exe on your PATH.

settings.label: Lock the vault after this many idle minutes
settings.hint: 0 keeps it unlocked until you close Breached or run :bw.exe lock.

settings.label: When a site asks for a passkey
settings.hint: Bitwarden's passkeys for the site show as rows to pick from, or the only one is used without asking. New passkeys can be kept in Bitwarden either way.
options: Show Bitwarden's passkeys to pick from
Use Bitwarden's passkey without asking when there's one
